title: Oven Roasted Syrian Bulgur Pilaf
description: A malty and crumbly one-pot Syrian dish featuring fresh basil and caramelized flavors, wrapped in a ti-leaf for an authentic touch, this ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly pilaf is perfect for a weeknight dinner
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, rinse the bulgur and soak it in water for 30 minutes.
Drain the water and set the bulgur aside in a large oven-safe pot.
In the same pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat on the stovetop.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Stir in the chopped basil, salt, and black pepper.
Add the soaked bulgur to the pot, stirring to combine with the onion and spice mixture.
Wrap the ti-leaves around the pot, securing with kitchen twine if needed.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and roast for 25 minutes.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes before serving.
